reuse.why: Extends the existing getMonthActionCategories selection so setZero and the forEachMonthActionCategory-based actions inherit the rule, but copyPreviousMonth keeps its own inline filter chain instead of using the selection.

duplication.why: The fixed-group exclusion is applied twice, once in getMonthActionCategories and again as an extra early-return in copyPreviousMonth's own copy of the exclusion rules.

placement.why: The tag detection and group lookup live in actions.ts next to the month-action category selection, which is where the exclusion rules are; the regex could arguably sit with other note-tag helpers but none exists for groups.

scope.why: Only actions.ts, the BudgetData query column and tests are touched.

maintainability.why: The exclusion rule set now lives in two places (SQL+filter in getMonthActionCategories and the forEach early-returns in copyPreviousMonth), so a future rule must again be added twice; the rule is also split between SQL and a JS post-filter.

bypasses_abstraction.where: actions.ts copyPreviousMonth applies the fixed-group exclusion inline rather than going through getMonthActionCategories

one_place.where: getFixedCostGroupIds is shared, but the exclusion is applied separately in getMonthActionCategories (filter) and in copyPreviousMonth (fixedCostGroupIds.has check on getBudgetData rows)
